items.name: Playwright end-to-end testing
items.note: Daily driver on a 1,000+ test suite for a healthcare EHR, and the test layer of every project here.

items.name: Page Object Model and fixtures
items.note: Shared fixtures, parameterised page objects and role-based locators instead of brittle selectors.

items.name: Flaky-test forensics and pipeline triage
items.note: CI timeouts, date-boundary and hydration races, iframe and locator drift, version-gated specs across releases.

items.name: Accessibility and visual regression testing
items.note: axe-core checks in both themes, keyboard-only runs, and screenshot baselines reviewed with every change.

items.name: Exploratory testing and defect reports
items.note: 203 reproducible issues filed on the platform and its test suite, from data integrity to narrative rendering.

items.name: Release gating and defect triage
items.note: Regression risk assessment and release gating for a clinical product.

items.name: TypeScript and Angular
items.note: Feature work on the EHR front end: signals, CDK overlays, Storybook stories and unit tests.

items.name: React
items.note: Meta and IBM certified; React front ends in the PDF chat app and the school website.

items.name: Node.js back ends
items.note: Routes, migrations, email and auth flows on the EHR's Node.js service; Express APIs in course work.

items.name: Python, Django and FastAPI
items.note: Django REST Framework with role-based access, and a FastAPI retrieval service with streaming.

items.name: REST APIs, MongoDB and SQL
items.note: API design, token auth and throttling; MongoDB and SQL queries to reproduce and fix data bugs.

items.name: GitLab CI and GitHub Actions
items.note: Nightly multi-environment pipelines at work; gated deploys, Lighthouse budgets and a published Action on GitHub.

items.name: Jenkins
items.note: Playwright pipelines on Jenkins and GitHub Actions from the CI/CD for Test Automation course.

items.name: Docker
items.note: A locked-down sandbox for an autonomous coding agent, one-command stacks with Docker Compose, and Playwright's Docker image for reproducible screenshot baselines.

items.name: Storybook and visual baselines
items.note: Stories with mocked APIs and screenshot checks shipped with front-end changes.

items.name: Git and merge-request hygiene
items.note: Small, evidence-backed merge requests: 440 merged across two repositories in a year.

items.name: Claude API and structured outputs
items.note: Validated JSON outputs, prompt caching, context editing and token budgeting in three shipped tools, including a hand-written agent loop.

items.name: Retrieval-augmented generation
items.note: Hybrid vector and BM25 retrieval with native citations, measured with a golden-set eval.

items.name: AI tools in the daily workflow
items.note: AI-assisted coding and review inside a test-first loop: spec, build, test, ship with evidence.

items.note: Google AI Prompting Essentials and Vanderbilt's prompt engineering and AI agents courses.
